# osc_birme_browserhand (Resource)

Experience seamless and reliable web automation for AI agents with Browserhand. Execute tasks with precision, using stable element references instead of brittle selectors. Snapshot, act, recover, and reuse effortlessly, ensuring consistent automation in real browsing environments. Perfect for developers seeking robust and deterministic browser automation.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of browserhand

### Optional

- `max_concurrent_sessions` (String) Configuration option for maxconcurrentsessions
- `session_timeout_ms` (String) Timeout value in milliseconds or seconds

### Read-Only

- `external_ip` (String) The external Ip of the created instance (if available).
- `external_port` (Number) The external Port of the created instance (if available).
- `instance_url` (String) URL to the created instace
- `service_id` (String) The service id for the created instance
